audit.whatIsWrong: The chart gives Ziggs five of seven stages while the page's own mid, late and first-item text says Fiora wins every clean 1v1 and runs him down from her first item.
audit.why: The mirror audit resolved this on the Fiora side, setting stages 1 through first item to Fiora and 2+ items to Skill after finding the same internal contradiction. Restating that chart from this side keeps the pages consistent; the ratings invert.
audit.corrected: win[0..5] and phases[0..5].side to Fiora, win[6]/phases[6].side to Skill, ratings 4/4/3/3/3/3/5, and every why rewritten to argue the side it now sits under.

audit.whatIsWrong: No stage or spike carries a cooldown, and the level 6 spike treats Grand Challenge as a gap-close.
audit.why: Lunge is 13s at rank 1 falling to 6s, Riposte is 24s at rank 1, Bladework is 11s, and Grand Challenge is 110/90/70s at 500 range. Grand Challenge does not close a gap — it reveals all four vitals and grants move speed near the target, and completing it heals her and nearby allies. The gap is closed by Lunge and by Flash.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into whys[1], whys[3], phases[1].why, phases[3].why, spikes[0].text and early; whys[4] and phases[4].why restated on what Grand Challenge actually does.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the single interaction that decides this lane: Riposte turns your CC into a stun on you. It also omits Fiora's healing and Grand Challenge's true damage.
audit.why: Riposte parries all incoming damage and disables, then stabs — and if it blocked an immobilizing effect it stuns instead of slows. Hexplosive Minefield's slow is not an immobilize, but Satchel Charge's knockback is a displacement, so leading with either into an active Riposte is the mistake, and either way the parry eats the damage. Duelist's Dance heals her on every vital hit and Grand Challenge heals her and her allies on completion, so chip poke without Grievous Wounds funds her. Grand Challenge's vital damage is true damage, so MR does not blunt the execute, and Lunge applies on-hit effects, so her item build scales the burst rather than her ratios.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text and phases[3].why now carry the Riposte rule and the anti-heal buy; whys[0], whys[4], phases[0].why and phases[4].why carry the healing and the true damage; early rewritten.

edits.before: Level 1 Fiora has no ranged answer to Ziggs' Bouncing Bomb poke.
edits.after: Level 1 Duelist's Dance vitals heal her through your bomb chip.

edits.before: At level 2 Ziggs still zones her short-range Lunge with mines and Q.
edits.after: At level 2 Lunge is 13s but a vital hit heals and speeds her up.

edits.before: By level 3 Ziggs chunks Fiora on every step-up to the wave.
edits.after: By level 3 Bladework's slow lets her stick once she is in.

edits.before: Through 4-5 Fiora can't close the gap against Ziggs' full kit.
edits.after: Through 4-5 Riposte parries a bomb and stuns if you displace her.

edits.before: At 6 Ziggs still holds range and out-pokes before her R comes online.
edits.after: At 6 Grand Challenge deals true damage and heals her after the kill.

edits.before: With two items Ziggs out-scales and pokes Fiora off every objective.
edits.after: With two items your poke and her all-in roughly cancel out at range.

edits.before: Q bombs out-range every melee tool in the game — chunk Fiora on every last-hit attempt, but respect early minion aggro.
edits.after: Q out-ranges her 400 Lunge, but Duelist's Dance heals every vital she hits — chip alone does not win level 1 here.

edits.before: W Satchel online — your disengage button. You can now take a greedy trade and blast yourself out of the answer.
edits.after: W Satchel online — your disengage button. Spend it on her Lunge, because Riposte parries whatever you throw next.

edits.before: Full kit: E minefield behind you makes you nearly unchaseable. Bounce Q off the wave so Fiora can't read the angle.
edits.after: E minefield behind you slows her chase, but Bladework slows you first — bounce Q and never stand in her line.

edits.before: Stack Manaflow and chip Fiora below 60% — that's the zone where R + jungle help executes. Track Riposte before every step-up.
edits.after: Stack Manaflow and chip her, but never displace into Riposte: it parries the damage and stuns you if it blocks the knockback.

edits.before: Mega Inferno Bomb online — any chipped target or crashing wave is now your gold. Hold it for the sub-60% HP window.
edits.after: Mega Inferno Bomb is online, but Grand Challenge is true damage and heals her — R is escape damage, not a duel opener.

edits.before: Shadowflame + Torch makes the full rotation lethal, but the map matters more — rotate R to sieges and skirmishes.
edits.after: Shadowflame + Torch makes your rotation lethal at range and she still wins the 1v1 — rotate R to sieges, never duel.

edits.before: Fiora has no ranged poke and her Lunge (Q) is short-range, so pre-6 you sit at Bouncing Bomb (Q) distance and chunk her every step-up. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you so when she lunges in she eats the mines and the slow, and you can W (Satchel Charge) yourself away from her Riposte window.
edits.after: Her Lunge is only 400 range, so sit at Bouncing Bomb distance — but Duelist's Dance heals her off every vital, so buy Grievous Wounds early. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you, and never Satchel her while Riposte is up on its 24s: a blocked displacement turns that parry into a stun on you.

edits.before: You control the early lane completely — Fiora has no ranged tool and her Lunge (Q) is short, so poke her freely with Bouncing Bomb (Q) at max range. Wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you so her only engage eats mines and a slow.
edits.after: You hold the range early — her Lunge is 400 and 13s at rank 1 — but you do not own the lane: every vital she hits heals her back. Poke at max range, wall Hexplosive Minefield (E) between you, and buy anti-heal before you commit.

notes: Both packet suspectNames are FALSE POSITIVES (Hexplosive Minefield, Satchel Charge with verbs attached). The chart is one atomic paired group — fourteen side edits plus six ratings; phases[5].rating was already 5/10 and left alone. The Riposte-stun claim is scoped carefully: Riot's text says it stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect, so I wrote it against Satchel Charge's displacement and did NOT claim the minefield slow triggers it. Remaining inconsistency for a human: diff is the enum "HARD" while breakdown.difficulty and report[14] both say "Tricky matchup", and the page still refers to Fiora as 'he/his' in tldr, winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, breakdown.early, dosFull[1].t, dontsFull[1].t and report[0].
